referenceSeasons.note: Workbook reference: one pick in every round for each franchise, 13 each. No 2027 transfer is recorded in the supplied trade ledger through trade 92. These are reference holdings, not live database assets or a completed 2027 draft order.

notes: The 2026 grid is signed as updated through trade 92 at Draft_Pick_Grids!K1:L2. Its B19:I19 totals are 11,13,13,13,14,13,14,13 in columnOrder.

Season ranges use their starting draft year. Trade 83 at Trades!C104/E104 exchanges draft-2025 and draft-2024 picks. Trade 87 at Trades!C109/E109 returns Arod-original 2025 rounds 3 and 4 to Arod in exchange for Arod-original 2026 rounds 3 and 4. Trade 83 is not an additional 2026 transfer.

The 2025 return is corroborated by original/current ownership at '2025 Draft'!C20:D20 and C31:D31. The 2024 board likewise records Arod's original rounds 3 and 4 back with Arod at '2024 Draft'!C24:D24 and C27:D27.
Voided trades 16 and 19 and unexercised options do not change verified holdings. No recorded pick transfer refers to a draft later than 2026; the 2027 grid is the only later-year pick reference.

Original franchise, draft year, and round identify a pick. Per-round counts alone cannot prove identity or detect equal-round swaps. Historical draft-grid discrepancies are documented in docs/PICK_OWNERSHIP_RECONCILIATION.md.

The 2026 Draft tab contains A-H placeholders, so it is not evidence of the final draft order. Franchise 4 continues Edwin/Julian/Sebastian; franchise 6 continues Justin/Amber; franchise 8 continues Cars/Alex.
